description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the PurgeNamespaceResponse class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.namespaces package. It contains unit tests for JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, and behavior of the response class related to namespace purging in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PurgeNamespaceResponseTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the PurgeNamespaceResponse class, ensuring correctness of JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, and other behaviors.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test data used in multiple test cases, including JSON representation and headers.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the PurgeNamespaceResponse class instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that constructing a PurgeNamespaceResponse from JSON produces the expected object.

methods.name: successfulResponseToJson
methods.description: Verifies that a successful response object converts to the correct JSON representation.

methods.name: failedResponseToJson
methods.description: Verifies that a failed response object converts to the expected JSON with 'successful' set to false.

methods.name: getIdReturnsNamespace
methods.description: Checks that getId() returns the same value as getNamespace().

methods.name: getEntityIdReturnsNamespace
methods.description: Checks that getEntityId() returns an object whose string representation matches getNamespace().

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Ensures the string representation of the response contains expected details.
